valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: the two P/E routes disagree (market cap over net profit 12.71 against price over EPS 10.00) and the net-profit row contradicts the filing's own profit before tax less tax while price x shares x EPS reconciles with it, so the earnings row the P/E divides by has not been verified. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
